title: Flood mapping with radar
text: Repeat-pass L-band airborne radar (UAVSAR) mapped how flood extent changed during Hurricane Florence. Later work evaluates commercial Capella SAR for high-tide flooding with field validation.

title: Ghost forests on the Atlantic coast
text: A deep learning study with sub-meter aerial imagery mapped 11.9 million standing dead trees across 11 Atlantic-coast states and found extensive, previously undocumented ghost forests.

title: Canopy height from GEDI, optical, and SAR data
text: Interpretable machine learning fuses optical and SAR data with GEDI lidar samples to map canopy height in southeastern North Carolina.

title: Wetland vegetation from imaging spectroscopy, radar, and lidar
text: In the Peace-Athabasca Delta, airborne imaging spectroscopy mapped plant communities with over 85 percent accuracy. UAV lidar and radar added vegetation structure and flooding.

title: Coastal water clarity from ICESat-2
text: With collaborators at Oregon State University, I work on estimating how quickly light fades with depth in coastal water (the diffuse attenuation coefficient, Kd) from ICESat-2 photon profiles.
